facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility

response.justification: MOC-2022-0140 was raised at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility on 4 July 2022 following 1 recorded event in the archive, including INC-2026-009. The change assurance record covers 1 clause across 5 controlled documents. The intent is to strengthen the material unwanted event control named in the documents in scope. The record reached the state merged in the change stream.
response.risk_note: No control is relaxed by this change; the residual risk position is unchanged or improved, and the material unwanted event control set is preserved.
response.scope_note: The documents in scope are MOC-2019-0221, PRO-MEC-021, PTW-STD-002, STD-ISO-006 and STD-PTW-001.
